editorial:
Imagine the stress of your final year of high school mixed with the fear of losing the person you love most. You get to follow Lara Jean and Peter as they face the big question of where they will go to college. The vibe is super sweet and cozy, focusing on that bittersweet feeling of growing up and saying goodbye to childhood. It feels like a warm hug, capturing all those awkward and cute moments that make teen romances so fun to watch.

What really works here is the chemistry between the two leads; they feel like a real couple who actually care about each other. While the plot is pretty simple and predictable, it doesn't really matter because the emotions feel honest. If you are in the mood for something light and romantic, you should definitely check this out.
endingExplained: After a lot of worrying about long distance, Lara Jean and Peter decide to stay together even though they are going to different colleges. They realize that their love is strong enough to handle the distance. The movie ends with a sweet jump forward in time to their graduation. They share a romantic kiss and promise to make it work, giving you a happy and satisfying conclusion to their story.
targetAudience: Ideal for anyone who loves cute teen romances and happy endings.
